hero.intro: A focused team building production-grade decision intelligence for enterprises and governments.

homePreview.intro: A focused team building production-grade decision intelligence for enterprises and governments.

members.name: Naveen Kumar
members.bio: Founded Nainovate to make enterprise AI deployable in weeks, not quarters. Leads product direction and the partnerships that put GenX into regulated environments across India and the GCC.

detail.background: Fifteen years across enterprise software and data platforms before Nainovate, most of it spent close to the customers who had to run the thing after go-live. That shaped the product bet: decision intelligence that survives audit, procurement and a change of government.
owns: Product direction and the GenX roadmap
Pricing, commercial structure and delivery commitments

members.name: Suhaas
members.bio: Two decades across enterprise software and large-scale delivery. Advises Nainovate on AI governance, security posture, and the operating discipline needed to scale from proof-of-concept to production.

detail.background: Two decades running large-scale software delivery inside regulated organisations. Has taken more than one AI pilot through the gap between a working demo and a system a risk committee will sign off on — the gap where most of them die.
owns: Operating discipline as the team scales

members.name: Pranay Raavi
members.bio: Full-stack and AI developer on the GenX platform. Works across agent orchestration, the workspace experience, and the public web surface that puts the product in front of customers.

detail.background: Full-stack and AI developer working across the whole surface of GenX — the agent runtime underneath, the workspace people actually use, and the public web presence that gets them there. Prefers shipping a narrow thing that works to a broad thing that demos.
owns: Agent orchestration and the platform runtime

members.name: Dhanesh
members.bio: Developer on the GenX platform, focused on the data and retrieval layer. Builds the pipelines, integrations and evaluation tooling that keep agent output grounded in enterprise systems.

detail.background: Developer on the data and retrieval layer — the part that decides whether an agent answer is grounded in the enterprise systems of record or quietly invented. Builds the pipelines, connectors and evaluation harnesses that keep that honest.

principles.title: Small teams
principles.body: We keep teams deliberately small so decisions stay close to the work.

principles.title: Production first
principles.body: We design for deployment, observability, security and operational ownership — not just demos.

principles.title: Enterprise by default
principles.body: Governance, security and auditability are part of the architecture from the start, not added later.

cta.body: Bring us a decision that is slow, manual or unauditable today. We will show you what GenX does with it in production.
cta.hiringNote: Hiring selectively. If decision intelligence is the problem you want to work on, start a conversation.
